rows.assessment: Valid reservations remain permanent. Existing initialized-bucket aliases preserve movement at capacity. A true public identity predicate is not admission/capacity/authority/readiness, and an empty other-pool alias is not a fresh activation domain.
rows.next_action: Retain this behavior; do not add release/reassignment or erase historical backing to reclaim slots.

rows.assessment: Generic seal still supports deliberate converter-free test graphs. Selected ETH-payout release must bind the reviewed converter before seal; the one-time guard cannot repair omission later. Underlying raw ETH/fixed-ZZZ claims are not destroyed.
rows.next_action: Verify actual selected converter/ledger/controller/runtime binding before irreversible release setup; no universal new seal policy inferred.

rows.assessment: Selected release requires the reviewed bound helper/singleton before seal/first mint. Actual official-runtime local payment/artwork evidence does not prove hosted onboarding, approved fees/payers or live sale configuration.
rows.next_action: Verify actual helper/runtime/SeaDrop/NFT-keyed settings, sale stages, fee/net payment and platform acceptance.

rows.assessment: Current setter cannot extend an already expired configured sale end, even with zero mints/unsealed bootstrap. This retains irreversible royalty-cutoff semantics, not a generic liveness fix.
rows.next_action: Delay deadline commitment until schedule is viable; reconstruct a bad unused graph rather than silently reopen the cutoff. Actual timing remains release evidence.

rows.assessment: On-chain syntax guards cannot verify every prepared evolution path, correct art, immutable publication, content availability or OpenSea retrieval. Earlier 41-byte URI gas evidence does not qualify an arbitrary release root.

rows.assessment: Internal dependency coherence is not matching the fixed Robinhood native graph. One deployment ZZZ cannot retarget after seal. The planner rejects known declared-pin contradictions but makes no actual code/getter/state proof.
rows.next_action: Read actual deployed graph, code/immutables/decimals and fixed-ZZZ agreement at reviewed state before seal; token/core/chain changes need the reviewed exit/redeployment model.

rows.topic: Pending VRF and future provider/replacement liveness
rows.assessment: Unanswered old draws can block rotation/canonical replacement. Initial funded/consumer/callback acceptance remains unqualified; there is no admin reroll or trait selection. LP/terminal rights are separate.
rows.next_action: Qualify provider/funding/callback operations; pause only new mints on outage and preserve pending requests. No silent reroll recovery design.

rows.topic: Service-only compound waiting policy
rows.assessment: The user explicitly retained extra in-range/below-threshold waiting in keeper software. An authorized key using alternate code can ignore extra service rules where on-chain rules permit; an unauthorized outsider cannot call keeper paths. Contracts retain cooldown/value/custody controls.
rows.next_action: Retain chosen boundary; protect/revoke/rotate keeper key and preserve pending-first recovery. This is not an unresolved instruction to add on-chain policy.

rows.topic: Keeper slow-read due-decision lag
rows.assessment: Enabled due decisions refresh chain time after slow work and reject failed/retreated heads. Later real-submit dry-run tests cover crossing the hourly harvest boundary and malformed return refusal without pending/spend/success publication.
rows.next_action: Reuse recorded finite evidence; real host/provider/submission operation remains separate.

rows.topic: Emergency optional financial protections
rows.assessment: Governance deliberately chooses retained bits; omission can accept nearly total financial loss. Emergency does not waive exact authority, fixed identities, backing/callback accounting, terminal lifecycle or external asset transferability. No automatic fallback chooses a bypass.
rows.next_action: Preserve explicit manual authority/check masks; require fresh operation review and actual outcome inspection.

rows.topic: Cumulative turnover loss versus per-operation caps
rows.assessment: The user declined a cumulative maintenance cap. Per-operation3% default, hard ceiling10% and other independent floors do not establish a lifetime total-loss bound.
rows.next_action: Monitor actual cost/turnover; do not introduce a cumulative restriction or claim a profitable attack from exponent arithmetic alone.

rows.topic: Spot references, independent markets and manipulation
rows.assessment: Captured own-swap proof fixes self-rejection, not correlated source manipulation. Independent source/control/freshness, meaningful post-withdrawal bidirectional execution depth and final-price checks remain necessary. Sampled evidence/jitter is not continuous price or MEV immunity.
rows.next_action: Complete actual qualified feeds/routes/depth and operating execution evidence without widening limits or replacing reference truth.

rows.topic: Unallocated royalty recovery cohort at inclusion
rows.assessment: Approved recovery uses active rarity weights when allocation executes; reviewHash is not a frozen beneficiary list. Activation ahead of a pending recovery can join that cohort. Existing earned liabilities are separate.
rows.next_action: Use the documented optional deposit-stop/confirm/read/allocate/re-enable process if a stable recovery cohort is wanted. Do not globally pause allocation or silently change economic timing.

rows.topic: Terminal paired ETH+ZZZ delivery and hostile recipients/tokens
rows.assessment: Each NFT's terminal principal pair is atomic. Failed ZZZ can defer that NFT's ETH; failed isolated delivery retains exact backing. Global failure cannot be cured by an accounting test. Original-currency royalties and healthy claim entries can be selected separately.
rows.next_action: Use actual unpaid ledger/receipt truth and isolated owner retries. Splitting principal-pair liability is an additional reviewed accounting/UX decision, not silently implemented here.

rows.topic: Residual close, mode disable and same-main/full consolidation
rows.assessment: Raw residual close leaves attributed idle and desired mode unchanged; same-main consolidation already reinvests and modeOFF, with main identity/clock preserved. Full replacement closes both and does not itself disable desired future residual creation. Actual-core typed second-mint/burn rollback and both-leg harvest evidence is recorded, not a global branch guarantee.
rows.next_action: Use the correct existing operation; do not call a second add-LP step after successful consolidation or drop residual accounting on modeOFF.

rows.topic: Contribution-only funding versus accumulated incumbent idle/compound
rows.assessment: Existing compound released during a join can push idle over5%. The protected contribution atomically rejects rather than spending entrant funds on incumbent assets. The recorded sequence compounds at its independent eligible interval into the same LP, then retries the same contribution and drains exact rights.
rows.next_action: Monitor idle and perform eligible compound/rebalance/explicit reviewed recovery; no contribution auto-recentering or idle-cap removal.

rows.topic: Retired financial fixture reachability and nonreversible balance cheats
rows.assessment: Current native/fixed-token execution interfaces forward real math; setup funds synthetic cash outside operations; settlement/loss use reversible sends. Synthetic geometry remains declared and is not physical-v4 proof.
rows.next_action: Reuse recorded fixture/behavior stages; preserve scope and avoid resurrecting old ERC20/wrapper assumptions.

rows.assessment: Finite changes require actual recipient deltas, exact unit totals, reserve separation, transferred ownership, rollback and retry. Old <=received assertion and current rounding/native expected values were corrected without changing allocation economics.
